title: Choose the visual world for RRAND
question: The roll assigned The Pattern Leaflet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Pattern Leaflet
options.lineage: 1970s crochet pattern booklets and leaflets (Coats & Clark, Patons, Lion Brand)
options.thesis: Every piece is sold as its own pattern leaflet: issue number, skill rating, materials, and the rounds it took.
options.viewport: A marigold leaflet cover fills the screen: RRAND set huge in a soft heavy face, an 'Issue No.' badge, a live product photo in a rounded frame, and a working Add to basket under its price.
options.risk: Reads as retro pastiche if the notation is decoration rather than real product facts.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue: sold-out pieces get a struck-through 'frogged' row, items in the basket wear a stitch-marker clip.
Four inks only, site-wide; every colour on the page is one of them or its tint.
Palette law: tomato is reserved for the buy action and nothing else.
Layouts snap to the leaflet's column grid in whole units, never half-cells.

options.label: The Granny Square Blanket
options.thesis: The storefront is a blanket being joined: each category and product is one square, stitched in as you scroll.
options.viewport: A full-width blanket of colour squares with RRAND worked into the centre square; squares lift and turn on hover.
options.risk: The most obvious crochet motif; most runs for a crochet shop land somewhere near here.

options.label: Pop Record Sleeve
options.thesis: Each collection is a release: one flat saturated ground, a square-cropped hero piece, four pieces listed like tracks.
options.viewport: A tangerine ground flooding the screen, one bag cropped square, RRAND in a rounded logotype, four pieces listed in a corner.
options.case: Fuses well for trend-led shoppers; loses on showing that every piece is handmade.
options.risk: Strong look, but it says 'merch' more than 'made by hand'.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.thesis: Pieces painted as cobalt tile panels.
options.viewport: A cobalt tile frieze with framed product panels.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tiles are a different craft, and cobalt-only hides the yarn colours.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: Products strung as frames on a rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail of product frames on black.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to yarn or gifting.
options.risk: Cold and technical for a handmade brand.
options.kept: State shown as a mark, not a colour.

options.label: Kiosk Print
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of label cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: bans photos, and the pieces must be seen.
options.risk: Austere where the brand is warm.

options.label: Arcade Pixel Glow
options.viewport: A pixel stage with sprite products.
options.case: Fuses poorly: screen-native, the opposite of handmade.
options.kept: One colour reserved by law for one meaning.

options.label: Multiplane Dawn
options.thesis: Painted forest planes drifting toward a cottage.
options.viewport: Layered painted forest sinking toward a lit window.
options.case: Fuses weakly: needs painted assets that don't exist; buries the products.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A soft, pastel handmade-boutique storefront, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Hero photo with headline and Shop button, category row and product grid below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other handmade shop by design.
